nlpSmarty.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter inside your NLP-start virtual environment.

nlpSmarty.engineDirectory.description: Path to directory containing bridge_server.py, app.py, and pipeline.py (defaults to extension root).

nlpSmarty.downstreamBackend.description: Downstream LLM backend for side-by-side comparison ('auto' uses vscode.lm Copilot if available, else HuggingFace app.py).

nlpSmarty.huggingFaceToken.description: Optional HuggingFace API token (HF_TOKEN) when using the HuggingFace app.py backend.

nlpSmarty.huggingFaceModel.description: HuggingFace model ID for app.py downstream evaluation.

nlpSmarty.maxTokenBudget.description: Maximum total token budget for the compiled prompt payload.
